flashcard_questions.q: Which body regulates advertising across all forms of media?
Which body regulates broadcasting and telecoms in the UK?
Which body classifies films and cinema trailers?
Which system rates video games across Europe?
What must the ASA check about the claims made in an advert?
flashcard_questions.a: That they are truthful and can be evidenced.

flashcard_questions.q: What action can the ASA take against a misleading advert?
flashcard_questions.a: It can require the advert to be changed or withdrawn.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the watershed rule Ofcom applies to broadcasting?
flashcard_questions.a: Content shown before 9pm must be suitable for children.

flashcard_questions.q: Which BBFC rating means adults only?
Which BBFC rating allows a younger child into the cinema with an adult?
What does the BBFC rating U mean?
What do PEGI content descriptors show a buyer?
flashcard_questions.a: The type of content, such as violence or bad language.
A document identifying hazards, how likely they are to cause harm, and the controls used.

flashcard_questions.q: When must a risk assessment be completed?

flashcard_questions.a: A pre-production visit to a potential filming location.

flashcard_questions.q: Which safety check must all electrical equipment on set pass?

notes: 15 cards: 4 body-to-remit, 4 regulator-action cards, 3 classification ratings, 2 term-to-definition, 1 timing, 1 safety control. Hazard lists were not carded as lists; PAT testing was carded as the single named electrical control.
